title: NFT Artist Neocrassical
body_markdown:
[https://www.youtube.com/c/GlobeOfficial](https://www.youtube.com/c/GlobeOfficial)


Globe.Exchange has enjoyed sitting down with NFT artist & metaverse experience architect, Neocrassical. In the interview, he talks about how he took the plunge from a previous field of music to an entirely new field with NFTs and has combined the two fields seamlessly to create his own unique content. He also shares his personal experiences and feelings in the NFT field and what the future holds for NFTS.


Neocrassical sells his NFT’s on Rarible, one of the fastest-growing NFT marketplaces for digital trading art, collectibles, music and video NFTs, metaverse items, and more. He proudly credits himself as the first person to create a comedy skit NFT, the first-ever audio-visual EP NFT, and the first-ever metaverse + real-world NFT Exhibition/Party UK.


Neocrassical recently released what would be the world’s first artist Whitepaper — ‘ ***The Neocrassical Theorems* ’** , a compendium of what he passed through to become an artist & the mental breakthroughs he discovered in the process. With the whitepaper, Neocrassical seeks to bridge economics, acting, art, music and spiritualism in a unique framework. The whitepaper is available on his[website](https://www.neocrassical.com/whitepaper) .


[https://www.neocrassical.com/](https://www.neocrassical.com/)


**More on NFTs: What are They?**


To understand NFTs, think of them as computer files combined with proof of ownership and authenticity, much like a deed. They are found on a blockchain, just like Bitcoin, but they differ from Bitcoin in that they are not fungible and thus have unique valuations set by the highest bidder. To sell NFT’s, artists who own them must first sign on to marketplaces, then “mint” digital tokens by uploading and validating their information on a blockchain. This can cost as low as $20 and as high as $500. Having done this, their NFT is eligible for listing, and they can set their price for the auction, similar to eBay.


**NFT’S and The New Future of Digital Art**


Neocrassical’s success is somewhat surprising, especially considering he took up the interest in music and creating content only a few years ago. NFT’s have opened up opportunities for artists, old and new, to showcase their skills through their creative works, sell on NFT marketplaces and earn money instead of having them lay by the side, offering no value to anyone.


The growth and adoption of NFTs across the board have been tremendous, considering digital artists who have been creating content that generates visits and engagement on Big Tech platforms like Facebook and Instagram for years while getting almost nothing in return plunged in quickly.


In fact, NFT’s have become so popular that collectors have spent millions of dollars on an array of NFT-based artwork, memes, and GIFs in the past year alone.
